lines.en: Hi, Dan! The printer is broken again. What happened?
lines.pt: Oi, Dan! A impressora quebrou de novo. O que aconteceu?

lines.en: Yes. I tried to print a big file, but the paper got stuck.
lines.pt: Sei. Tentei imprimir um arquivo grande, mas o papel enroscou.

lines.en: Oh no. Why did you print so many pages?
lines.pt: Ai, não. Por que você imprimiu tantas páginas?

lines.en: I printed them because the client wanted a paper copy.
lines.pt: Imprimi porque o cliente queria uma cópia em papel.

lines.en: I see. Did you call the repair man?
lines.pt: Entendi. Você ligou para o técnico?

lines.en: Yes, I called him because it was urgent. He came at noon.
lines.pt: Liguei, sim, porque era urgente. Ele veio ao meio-dia.

lines.en: No, he left because he needed a new part.
lines.pt: Não, ele saiu porque precisava de uma peça nova.

lines.en: I used the printer on the second floor because ours was broken.
lines.pt: Usei a impressora do segundo andar porque a nossa estava quebrada.

lines.en: Smart! I’ll send you my report, so you can print it, too.
lines.pt: Esperto! Vou te mandar meu relatório, então você pode imprimir também.

facts.label: Passado e motivos
facts.sub: Use o passado simples e because + sujeito + verbo para explicar: I called him because it was urgent. Use so para o resultado.

facts.label: Motivos
facts.sub: Para dar um motivo, use because + sujeito + verbo: I called him because it was urgent. Para perguntar o motivo, use Why did you…? Why did you call him?

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para o que aconteceu: tried, printed, called, needed, left. Verbos regulares ganham -ed. Left é irregular, vem de leave.

facts.label: Problemas

pages.title: A modern office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday morning in a modern office in Auckland. A red light shines on the printer. Dan stands next to it with a paper in his hand. His coworker Yara walks over. The machine does not work. Yara wants to know why.
“Hi, Dan! The printer is broken again. What happened?” says Yara. “Yes. I tried to print a big file, but the paper got stuck.” says Dan. “Oh no. Why did you print so many pages?” says Yara.
